content: Debian manpages systemd.mount(5) systemd 257: nofail makes mount only wanted not required by local-fs.target and not ordered before it so boot continues regardless of mount success; x-systemd.device-timeout configures wait for device before giving up on fstab entry, takes seconds or unit suffix, valid only in /etc/fstab ignored in unit-file Options=; block-device mounts gain Requires+After on device unit. Source: https://manpages.debian.org/stable/systemd/systemd.mount.5.en.html
